name: Escape Fairwood
source:
Dolly wakes up in a strange house. She is covered in scratches and suffers from a terrible headache, as well as a slight amnesia : what happened earlier, and why is she here ?

[From [url=https://macatia-games.itch.io/escape-fairwood]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
多莉在一个陌生的房子里醒来。她满身抓痕，头痛欲裂，还有轻微的失忆症：之前发生了什么，她为什么会在这里？

[来自[url=https://macatia-games.itch.io/escape-fairwood]itch.io[/url]]
